newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's SEC approves Araneta capital hike.
newsitem.headline: Manila's SEC approves Araneta capital hike.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved Araneta Properties Inc's proposed authorised capital increase to five billion pesos from 300 million, the company said on Friday.
In an advisory to the stock exchange, the company also said its subscribed and paid-up capital rose to 1.56 billion pesos from 156.18 million.
Araneta Properties is developing a 1,500 hectare plot of land that straddles the boundaries of Quezon City, Caloocan City, Bulacan and Montalban, Rizal, located north of the capital.
The company said it also owns a ferrochrome smelting plant in Cagayan de Oro City in southern Philippines.
